targetDefinition.Target: sum of LineTotalNet over non-dues (non PROD-MEM*) lines on Confirmed Sale orders never reversed (final status), OrderDate in (decision_date, decision_date + 365 d]

sizingNote: 4873 rows (1489 persons), the rows the corpus holds (Ruling Q9: real data is what it is). 3184 positive; mean 272.34, SE 4.16 (relative SE 0.0153); zero share 0.3466, SE 0.0068; max / mean 6.55.
